verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a first-party hosted MCP server (mcp.posthog.com/mcp) with extensive tool coverage, OAuth-based auth, scoping, and CLI mode, and this is independently probed (401 with OAuth metadata) confirming it's live rather than just claimed. It works with numerous standard MCP clients (Cursor, Claude, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, etc.) per posthog-supp-mcp-hosted-clients. missing for 10: no independent hands-on user report of successfully connecting an agent via the MCP server (only vendor docs and infra probes, plus one unrelated community complaint about LLM cohort creation that doesn't concretely test MCP itself).
